verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents one-line install commands (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`) and a real runtime probe confirms `npx -y skills add anthropics/skills --skill skill-creator ... --copy` actually fetches and installs a skill into `.claude/skills/` with a valid SKILL.md, ready for the next session. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration beyond the single probe, and explicit confirmation the skill is 'active' (auto-loaded) immediately in the next session rather than just present on disk.
